description:
Design (page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.28.html; APPROVED 2026-10-17):
- The tuple top already exists as the factor-less tuple clause (part of any). Add Descr::tuple_top, Types::tuple_top (trait src/types/mod.rs:131, forward compiler2/types/mod.rs:2976, interned like map_top), and a registry entry `tuple` with Arity::Fixed(0). No tuple(T, U) spelling (decided): {T, U} stays the only fixed-arity form.
- The runtime test already exists on all three paths (TupleShapes::any; native/receive check "struct kind, not a named struct").
- Fold: "contains a tuple" becomes one memoized Types question. It replaces the max_tuple_arity != 0 proxy, which is wrong for the top and for {}, at jobs/contract.rs:287 and :340 and native_codegen/value.rs:147 (ty_has_tuple). dispatch_reachability.rs:347 and arrow_match.rs:473, :527, :541 keep max_tuple_arity, with probes confirming they behave correctly for the top.
- is_tuple becomes a typed-head helper. elem and tuple_size state the tuple domain in their heads.
- Removes fz_is_tuple (from fz-sc8.9), the "tuple deliberately absent" comment and its two pins (restated), and type-naming.md:129-130.
- Oracle fixture on all three paths. t :: tuple accepts {}, {1} and {1,2,3}, and rejects 5, a list, a map and a named struct, both as a typed head and through is_tuple in a guard. A C extern with a tuple parameter is refused.
- defimpl for: Tuple is fz-sc8.29.
title: tuple names the type of every tuple
